name: Real Estate Agent
imageAlt: Real Estate Agent performing commercial work
seoTitle: Business Insurance Cost for Real Estate Agents

industryContext.contextNote: Real estate agents guide clients through high-value transactions with significant financial stakes, making disclosure and representation errors the central liability concern.

riskFactors.title: Disclosure & Misrepresentation Claims
riskFactors.description: A missed property defect disclosure or inaccurate representation during a sale can lead to claims from buyers after closing.

riskFactors.title: Transaction Documentation Errors
riskFactors.description: Mistakes in contracts, disclosures, or closing paperwork can create legal exposure given the high dollar value of real estate deals.

riskFactors.title: Fiduciary Duty Disputes
riskFactors.description: Agents owe fiduciary duties to clients, and perceived breaches, such as favoring one party in a dual-agency deal, can trigger claims.

faqs.question: Why do real estate agents need Errors & Omissions insurance?
faqs.answer: E&O covers claims tied to disclosure mistakes, misrepresentation, or documentation errors during a transaction, which is the core liability risk in real estate sales.

faqs.question: What is the average cost of business insurance for a real estate agent?
faqs.answer: A real estate agent in the $0-50k revenue tier pays an estimated $285 per year for baseline General Liability coverage.

faqs.question: Does my brokerage's E&O policy cover me as an individual agent?
faqs.answer: Many brokerages carry a firm-wide E&O policy, but coverage limits and gaps vary, so many agents carry supplemental individual coverage as well.

faqs.question: Do real estate agents need coverage after a home sale closes?
faqs.answer: Yes. E&O claims are often filed well after closing once a buyer discovers an undisclosed defect, so coverage needs to extend beyond the transaction date.

blogContent.whyThisRiskFactor: Real estate agents carry a 1.2 actuarial risk factor, reflecting significant transaction-related liability tied to the high dollar value of property sales.
blogContent.howCalculated: Premiums scale with revenue tier, team size, and Errors & Omissions endorsements specific to real estate transactions.
blogContent.comparisonNote: Real estate agent premiums are comparable to dog groomers and massage therapists, and higher than most desk-based professional-services consultants.
